root_cause.evidence: Commit message states: "The for loop finishes with cb->args[0] == nf_ct_helper_hsize, and the 'goto restart' jumps back into the loop body bypassing the bounds check, causing an 8-byte out-of-bounds read on nf_ct_helper_hash[nf_ct_helper_hsize]." The patch moves the restart block inside the for loop to ensure the bounds check is still active.
